title: Took direct charge of Xpeng's robotics unit on June 10
statement: Took direct charge of Xpeng's robotics unit on June 10, 2026, ahead of imminent mass production of its humanoid robot.
outcome: As of the June 10, 2026 Reuters report, Xpeng's humanoid robot mass production was described as imminent under He's direct oversight; the actual production launch outcome was not covered in sources fetched in this pass.

title: Accepted appointment as an independent director of Ant Group's board
statement: Accepted appointment as an independent director of Ant Group's board, announced June 22, 2026.
outcome: He became a sitting independent director on Ant Group's board as of the June 22, 2026 disclosure.
